_metadata.description: Season2 public cases for 910c; performance revalidation pending
_metadata.baseline_policy: Missing baseline durations, and degenerate ones equal to t_hw_us (zero scoring span), are estimated as 3 * t_hw_us, corresponding to one third of theoretical performance; these are not hardware measurements. Cap all baselines at 3 * t_hw_us, then round to at most three decimal places using ROUND_HALF_UP; preserve all t_hw_us.
